public.text: The legal examples focus on jurisdictions with emerging formal AI frameworks. Many countries do not yet have specific AI legislation and may need to govern AI through existing health, medical-device, data-protection, professional, and administrative law.
public.suggestedRevision: Explain how countries can use existing legal and regulatory mechanisms while dedicated AI governance matures.
